name: QFA 701 起落架问题 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 701, from Sydney to Wuhan, cruising at 10,700 meters, squawking 3211, you are entering Wuhan Control area, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 QFA 701，从悉尼飞往武汉，正以 10,700 米巡航，应答机 3211，正在进入武汉管制区，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，正保持 1,700 米，应答机 3211。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, Wuhan Control, radar contact, maintain 10,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，武汉管制，雷达识别，保持 10,700 米。

cards.audioText: B: There is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, asked how the preceding aircraft avoided the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：LKO 附近有雷暴发展，询问前机如何避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, there is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, how did the preceding aircraft avoid the weather ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，LKO 附近有雷暴发展，前机如何避开天气？

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 701, the preceding aircraft just deviate 5 miles to the east, what's your intention?
B: tell Wuhan Control you want to deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： QFA 701，前机刚刚向东偏航 5 英里，你的意图是什么？
B： 告诉武汉管制，为避开天气，你希望向东偏航 20 英里。
cards.referenceText: request deviate 20 miles to the east, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求向东偏航 20 英里，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: You are approaching the top of decent point but there are CBs at lower level, ask Wuhan Control to delay your descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正接近下降顶点，但低高度有 CB，请求武汉管制延迟下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request delay descent due CBs at lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因低高度有 CB，请求延迟下降。

cards.audioText: B: There are thunderstorms sources the south of the airport, arrival through LKO is difficult, ask Wuhan Control for an approach from the North and use ZF arrivals.
cards.audioTextZh: B：机场南侧有雷暴，难以经 LKO 进场，请求武汉管制从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request approach from the north and ZF arrival due thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因雷暴，请求从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, turn right heading 020, expect ZF-02 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，右转航向 020，预期 ZF-02 进场。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 020, expect ZF-02 arrival, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 020，预期 ZF-02 进场，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: Now there is a small cumulonimbus in front of you, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你前方有一小块积雨云，请求在右侧 2 英里范围内机动。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request maneuver two miles to the right due a small CB.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因一小块 CB，请求向右机动 2 英里。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your nose wheel steering failed, informed Wuhan Approach of the situation and tell him that you will stop on the runway after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，你的前轮转弯失效，通知武汉进近情况，并告诉他你将在落地后停在跑道上。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 701, our nose wheel steering failed, we will stop on the runway after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 701，我们的前轮转弯失效，落地后将停在跑道上。

cards.audioText: You are told to use Runway 22VOR/DME approach, but the weather is deteriorating, ask Wuhan Tower for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 你被告知使用 Runway 22 VOR/DME 进近，但天气正在恶化，向武汉塔台请求 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, request ILS approach Runway 18L, deteriorating weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，因天气恶化，请求 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, ILS approach Runway 18L is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，批准 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: The approach lights are not bright enough, asked Tower to increase the brightness of the approach lights.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近灯不够亮，请塔台提高进近灯亮度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, the approach lights are not bright enough, request brighten up the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，进近灯不够亮，请求调亮进近灯。

cards.audioText: B: You executed missed approach because of poor visibility, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你因能见度差执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, going around due poor visibility.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，因能见度差，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，收到，执行标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, QFA 701.

cards.audioText: QFA 701, the visibility has improved now, expect radar vectors for another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，现在能见度已经改善，预计雷达引导再次进近。
cards.referenceText: roger, expect radar vectors for another approach, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计雷达引导再次进近，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，右转航向 090，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach Runway 18L, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: You have landed at Wuhan Airport, but the tow truck is not in position, ask for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已在武汉机场着陆，但拖车未就位，请求牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 701, the tow truck is not in position, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 701，拖车未就位，请求牵引车。
